style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft urban outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper white #F5F0E4, fog blue #C7D3D6, deep ink teal #24343A and one burnt sienna accent #A85C32; soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and low-contrast contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icons and slim underline rules only; clean editorial outerwear photography mixed with minimal infographic blocks; the long coat silhouette stays fully visible hood to hem at a stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the long coat silhouette is always fully visible hood to hem; stable scale across the set; garment never clipped by the frame
